An https link is extracted into metadata.links when extract_metadata is true

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using HtmlToMarkdown;

var result = HtmlToMarkdownConverter.Convert("<p>See <a href=\"https://example.com\">Example</a> for details.</p>", new ConversionOptions { ExtractMetadata = true });
Console.WriteLine(result.Content);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Links);
```
